## Summary

A short description of what you would like to see.

## Motivation

Why would this be useful? Who does it help?

## Proposed solution

Describe how you think this could work.

## Design check

Please confirm that the proposed feature is consistent with the project's philosophy:

- [ ] This change does not alter the core mechanics or pacing of HM64
- [ ] This change does not change the tone or identity of the original game
- [ ] This is a non-invasive convenience, or an optional improvement
- [ ] A player who doesn't know the fork exists would not notice an unwanted change

## Alternatives considered

Are there simpler or different ways to solve the same problem?

## Additional context

Any other context, references, or screenshots.
